description: H205F22 W1 parameterless enrollment of a persistent non-root P-256 callback signing key. The private key never leaves the instance; stdout contains only public JWK binding and nonauthority metadata.

runCommand:
set -eu
umask 077
EXEC_USER='metaengine-w1'
IDENTITY_ROOT='/var/lib/metaengine/w1/identity'
PRIVATE_KEY="$IDENTITY_ROOT/callback-es256-private.pem"
PUBLIC_DER="$IDENTITY_ROOT/callback-es256-public.der"
PUBLIC_JWK="$IDENTITY_ROOT/callback-es256-public.jwk.json"
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1
command -v runuser >/dev/null 2>&1
id "$EXEC_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1
install -d -o "$EXEC_USER" -g "$EXEC_USER" -m 0700 "$IDENTITY_ROOT"
TOKEN="$(curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 -X PUT \
  -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60' \
  'http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token')"
test -n "$TOKEN"
INSTANCE_ID="$(curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 \
  -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" \
  'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id')"
case "$INSTANCE_ID" in
  i-[0-9a-f]*) ;;
  *) exit 41 ;;
esac
runuser -u "$EXEC_USER" -- env \
  METAENGINE_W1_PRIVATE_KEY="$PRIVATE_KEY" \
  METAENGINE_W1_PUBLIC_DER="$PUBLIC_DER" \
  METAENGINE_W1_PUBLIC_JWK="$PUBLIC_JWK" \
  METAENGINE_W1_INSTANCE_ID="$INSTANCE_ID" \
  python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, stat, subprocess, tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone

SCHEMA='metaengine.compute.w1-callback-key-enrollment.h205f22.v1'
PREFIX='METAENGINE_W1_CALLBACK_KEY_ENROLLMENT_JSON='
ALGORITHM='ES256-P1363-SHA256'
SPKI_PREFIX=bytes.fromhex('3059301306072a8648ce3d020106082a8648ce3d03010703420004')
private_key=pathlib.Path(os.environ['METAENGINE_W1_PRIVATE_KEY'])
public_der=pathlib.Path(os.environ['METAENGINE_W1_PUBLIC_DER'])
public_jwk=pathlib.Path(os.environ['METAENGINE_W1_PUBLIC_JWK'])
instance_id=os.environ['METAENGINE_W1_INSTANCE_ID']
if not instance_id.startswith('i-'):
    raise RuntimeError('instance_id_invalid')

def b64u(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b'=').decode('ascii')

def canonical(value) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')

private_key.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
if private_key.exists():
    st=private_key.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError('private_key_not_regular')
    if stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) != 0o600:
        raise RuntimeError('private_key_mode_invalid')
else:
    fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.callback-es256-',dir=str(private_key.parent))
    os.close(fd)
    os.chmod(tmp,0o600)
    try:
        proc=subprocess.run(
            ['openssl','genpkey','-algorithm','EC','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:P-256','-out',tmp],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=False)
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError('private_key_generation_failed')
        os.replace(tmp,private_key)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)
st=private_key.lstat()
if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) != 0o600:
    raise RuntimeError('private_key_postcondition_invalid')
proc=subprocess.run(
    ['openssl','pkey','-in',str(private_key),'-pubout','-outform','DER'],
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=False)
if proc.returncode != 0 or len(proc.stdout) != 91 or not proc.stdout.startswith(SPKI_PREFIX):
    raise RuntimeError('public_key_der_invalid')
point=proc.stdout[len(SPKI_PREFIX):]
if len(point)!=64:
    raise RuntimeError('public_key_point_invalid')
jwk={'crv':'P-256','kty':'EC','x':b64u(point[:32]),'y':b64u(point[32:])}
key_id=hashlib.sha256(canonical(jwk)).hexdigest()
for path,data,mode in (
    (public_der,proc.stdout,0o644),
    (public_jwk,canonical(jwk)+b'\n',0o644),
):
    fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.'+path.name+'.',dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as handle:
            handle.write(data)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        os.chmod(tmp,mode)
        os.replace(tmp,path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)
record={
    'schema':SCHEMA,
    'provider_kind':'AWS_EC2',
    'provider_instance_id':instance_id,
    'algorithm':ALGORITHM,
    'key_id':key_id,
    'public_jwk':jwk,
    'observed_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'private_key_exported':False,
    'canonical':False,
    'authority_effect':False,
    'worker_admitted':False,
    'w1_verified':False,
    'persistent_worker_proof':False,
    'reboot_completion_proven':False,
}
line=PREFIX+canonical(record).decode('utf-8')
if len(line.encode('utf-8'))>4096:
    raise RuntimeError('enrollment_stdout_too_large')
print(line)
PY
